name: Immersive Photo
tagline: A dark, image-led template for a journal that photographs and sells prints.
description: An immersive, photo-led journal on a near-black cinematic ground where the photography carries all the colour — a full-bleed photo cover, a photo-forward feed, a chaptered photo-essay band, and a bespoke photo-forward article reader, lit by one luminous solar-amber accent. Modelled on the immersive-photojournalism archetype; shipped as Wayfarer, a travel & photography journal. Ships a light store (fine-art prints, field gear, a photobook) to demonstrate content + commerce together.
